title: Sextus Julius Africanus, Chronographiae (fragments); «Хронография» Юлия Африкана
author: Sextus Julius Africanus
language: Greek (with Latin, Syriac and Armenian testimonia)
size: About 100 fragments plus testimonia, est. 20–30k words
edition: Routh, Reliquiae sacrae II (1846; public domain). Wallraff et al., GCS NF 15 (2007; in copyright)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Секст Юлий Африкан) lists only the Russian Martyrdom of Symphorosa (vostlit). No Chronographiae
en_evidence: Wallraff (ed.), Chronographiae: The Extant Fragments, translated by W. Adler (2007), per en.wikipedia
other_translations: None found beyond the English in GCS
value: The founding text of Christian world chronography (the 5,500-year scheme, Olympiad synchronisms). Source for Eusebius, Synkellos and the Paschale; important for Jewish-Hellenistic chronology.
ai_feasibility: Medium-high: short fragments. The main difficulty is separating verbatim quotation from paraphrase in the citing authors
pilot_unit: The Moses–Ogyges synchronism and Olympiad-chronology fragments, est. 4k words
